items.title: Germany reportedly switches Lithuania exercise equipment transport to rail
items.summary: Germany reportedly changed plans to move military equipment for the Grand Eagle 26 exercise in Lithuania, opting for rail transport rather than road convoys through Poland. Reports citing Bild say the change followed NATO consultations amid concerns that a conspicuous armoured movement near Belarus could heighten tensions with Russia.

items.title: Lavrov criticizes German and British defence leaders over strikes on Russia
items.summary: Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov criticized statements by German and British defence leaders concerning Ukrainian strikes on Russian territory. The remarks followed a disagreement in which Germany's Boris Pistorius apologized for his wording in response to US Deputy Defense Secretary Elbridge Colby's criticism of deep strikes.
